trip.label: Fri 28 – Mon 31 August 2026
trip.weather: Late Aug: highs ~27 °C, lows ~17 °C. Sunset 19:40. Roughly 8 rain days in the month — pack one light layer for terraces at night.
trip.currency: Hungary uses the forint (HUF). ~390–400 HUF to €1. Cards work almost everywhere.

airport.name: Liszt Ferenc International
airport.buffer_note: Schengen-to-Schengen — no passport queue. Allow ~25 min from wheels-down to standing at the bus stop, more if you checked a bag.

routes.label: Uber, Bolt or Főtaxi
routes.cost: ~€25–35 for the car, split between you

steps.text: One car from the terminal to the front door. Főtaxi is the official rank right outside arrivals; Uber and Bolt pickup are signposted.

routes.warning: The only sane option late at night, and cheap if you land together and share. Uber runs in Budapest through Főtaxi, so the car is a regulated yellow taxi at the regulated fare — same price as everyone else, just a nicer app.

routes.label: 100E Airport Express
routes.cost: 2,500 HUF for the 100E, plus one standard ticket for the last leg

steps.text: Bus 100E from Terminal 2 straight to Deák Ferenc tér. No transfer, every 6–10 min.
Onward from Deák Ferenc tér — the middle of the city, a few minutes from most places.

routes.label: 200E bus + M3 metro
routes.cost: Two standard tickets, ~900 HUF (~€2.30) — or nothing extra on a travelcard

steps.text: Bus 200E from Terminal 2 to Kőbánya-Kispest, the southern end of the M3 metro.
M3 metro north into town, then onward.

airport.night_note: Landing after ~22:30 the metro is closing (last M3 around 23:20). The 200E runs all night but terminates at Határ út after hours, and you would be stitching night buses together at 01:00 with luggage. Take a car.

getting_around.d: Gyöngyösi utca on the M3 (blue line). ~15 min to Deák Ferenc tér, the middle of everything.
Buy in the BudapestGO app. A 72-hour travelcard covers Fri–Mon and removes all thinking. Single tickets need validating; the app's don't.
Around 23:20. After that it is night buses (BudapestGO plans them for you) or a car — 15–20 min home from District VII.
District VII. Almost everything on the picks board is within ten minutes of Kazinczy utca on foot.
A 2.5 km park island in the middle of the Danube, on the tram 4/6 line — the easy answer to a free morning or a bag-drop gap.

money.d: If the card terminal offers to charge you in euros, say no. Dynamic currency conversion costs you 5–10% every time.
Barely needed. Keep ~10,000 HUF for markets and the odd cloakroom.
Use bank ATMs (OTP, K&H, Erste). Avoid the blue Euronet ones — bad rates, big fees.
10% is normal. Check the bill first — many District VII places already add a service charge.

clash.title: Saturday night collides
clash.body: Sparty runs Saturdays only, so Sat 29 Aug is the only shot at it. The Remember Parade at Budapest Park — ATB, Ferry Corsten, Umek, Da Hool, Brooklyn Bounce — is the same evening. You get one. The picks board is currently split.

airport.name: 100E airport ticket
airport.where: Purple BKK machine just outside the terminal exit, or in the BudapestGO app. Not sold on board — and a normal single or a travelcard is NOT valid on the 100E.

single.name: Standard single ticket
single.where: BudapestGO app, or a purple BKK machine — there is one at every metro entrance and most big stops. Paper tickets need validating at the little box; app tickets you activate before you board. Buying from the driver costs more.

travelcard.name: 72-hour travelcard
travelcard.where: BudapestGO or any purple machine. Covers Fri–Mon on metro, tram, bus and trolley — everything except the 100E. Pays for itself at about four journeys, and you stop thinking about tickets entirely.

none.name: No ticket needed
none.where: Uber and Bolt charge the card on file. A Főtaxi from the official rank runs on the meter — pay by card in the car.

apps.name: BudapestGO
apps.what: Buy and activate tickets on your phone, and plan any journey door to door with live departures. It replaces hunting for a ticket machine, and it's the only way to buy without cash or a card terminal.
